Description: Susceptible people are exposed to contaminated water and become infected.
Infectious people recover and become immune.

Name: β
Description: Rate of 'contact' with reservoir water, representing the maximum infection rate.

Name: γ
Description: Per capita recovery rate, the reciprocal of the duration of cholera infection.

Name: δ
Description: Decay rate of cholera in the water reservoir, the reciprocal of the cholera life span in water.

Name: ξ
Description: Rate of water contamination by infectious humans shedding V. cholerae.

Name: κ
Description: Concentration of cholera that yields a 50% chance of infection (half-saturation constant).
